mainEntity.name: How can AI help me understand what customers actually want?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with customer problems and buying situations, not only demographic labels. AI can cluster reviews, survey responses, support messages, search questions, and interview notes into themes such as desired outcomes, objections, frustrations, and language customers use. Context matters because public comments may overrepresent unusually happy or unhappy people. Key factors include: - source quality and recency - repeated themes versus isolated remarks - customer segment and purchase stage - whether comments describe your market or a neighboring one. Use a research assistant to organize verbatim evidence and themes, then confirm important conclusions with direct customer conversations or a focused survey.
acceptedAnswer.description: Feed AI customer reviews, survey responses, interview notes, support questions, and search language, then ask it to group recurring needs, objections, desired outcomes, and customer wording. Separate repeated evidence from isolated comments and validate major conclusions with real customer conversations.
